phase_prompt.summary: Initial dormant state of the obelisk with faint glyphs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering basalt obelisk, 30 m tall, tapering to a pointed apex, etched with faint Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs. Embedded crystalline cores emit a subtle blue glow, surrounded by a metal alloy lattice. The chamber is dimly lit, dust motes drift in shafts of filtered light, creating a tactile, industrial mysticism atmosphere.
